title: The Art of Persuasion
completion_message: ¡Soberbio! El vocabulario de la persuasión es la herramienta definitiva del liderazgo. Palabras como 'Leverage', 'Capitalize on' o 'Synergy' te permiten transformar una simple propuesta en una visión irrefutable. Eres un verdadero maestro de la retórica.

parts.visual:
1. Leverage (Apalancar / Aprovechar): 
- Usar algo para obtener la máxima ventaja. 
Ej: We need to leverage our existing customer base to launch the new product. 

2. Capitalize on (Sacar partido de / Aprovechar): 
- Tomar ventaja de una situación u oportunidad. 
Ej: We must capitalize on the competitor's recent PR disaster. 

3. Pivot (Pivotar / Cambiar de dirección): 
- Cambiar radicalmente la estrategia de negocio. 
Ej: The startup had to pivot from hardware to software to survive.
parts.audio: Welcome to The Art of Persuasion. Number 1: Leverage. This means to use something to maximum advantage. For example: We need to leverage our existing customer base to launch the new product. Number 2: Capitalize on. To take advantage of a situation or opportunity. For example: We must capitalize on the competitor's recent P R disaster. Number 3: Pivot. This means to radically change the business strategy. For example: The startup had to pivot from hardware to software to survive.

parts.visual:
4. Synergy / Synergies (Sinergia): 
- El beneficio combinado de dos empresas que se unen, que es mayor que la suma de sus partes. 
Ej: The merger will create massive synergies in our supply chain. 

5. Buy-in (Aceptación / Apoyo): 
- El acuerdo o apoyo de otras personas a tu idea. 
Ej: We need the board's buy-in before we can proceed. 

6. To spearhead (Liderar / Encabezar): 
- Liderar una iniciativa o ataque. 
Ej: She will spearhead the new marketing campaign. 

7. Value proposition (Propuesta de valor): 
- La innovación o característica que hace que el producto sea atractivo. 
Ej: Our unique value proposition is our 24/7 customer support.
parts.audio: Number 4: Synergy. The combined benefit of two companies joining together, which is greater than the sum of their parts. For example: The merger will create massive synergies in our supply chain. Number 5: Buy-in. Agreement or support for an idea. For example: We need the board's buy-in before we can proceed. Number 6: To spearhead. To lead an initiative. For example: She will spearhead the new marketing campaign. Number 7: Value proposition. The feature that makes a product attractive to customers. For example: Our unique value proposition is our 24/7 customer support.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la palabra retórica o de persuasión correcta.

questions.question: We must ____ our network of influencers to promote the new brand. (Aprovechar/Apalancar).
The company failed because they didn't ____ on the growing trend of remote work. (Sacar partido).
questions.explanation: Capitalize on = sacar provecho/partido de algo.

questions.question: When their main product failed, the startup had to ____ to a new business model. (Pivotar/Cambiar).
questions.explanation: Pivot = pivotar, cambiar radicalmente de estrategia.

questions.question: By merging the two departments, we can create significant ____ and save costs. (Sinergias).
Before we launch the initiative, we need to get ____ from the executive team. (Apoyo/Aceptación).
questions.explanation: Buy-in = aceptación, apoyo a una idea.

questions.question: The Vice President will ____ the new expansion into the Asian market. (Encabezar/Liderar).
questions.explanation: Spearhead = liderar, encabezar (literalmente: ser la punta de la lanza).

questions.question: Our unique ____ proposition is that our software is completely open-source. (Propuesta de valor).
To convince the investors, you need a compelling elevator ____. (Discurso de venta rápido).
questions.explanation: Elevator pitch = discurso rápido y persuasivo.

questions.question: We need to align our ____ with the company's long-term vision. (Incentivos).
They used aggressive ____ to force the competition out of the market. (Tácticas).
The negotiator used a very persuasive ____ to convince the union leaders. (Retórica).
questions.explanation: Rhetoric = retórica, el arte de la persuasión.

questions.question: His argument was completely ____. Nobody could find a single flaw in it. (Irrefutable/Hermético).
questions.explanation: Watertight (o airtight) argument = argumento irrefutable, sin fisuras.

questions.question: We need to ____ the narrative before the press releases the story. (Controlar/Dirigir).
questions.explanation: Control the narrative = controlar la narrativa.

questions.question: The CEO is a master at building ____ with angry shareholders. (Relación/Sintonía).
questions.explanation: Build rapport = crear sintonía / buena relación.

questions.question: To close the deal, we had to offer a small ____ on the price. (Concesión).
His presentation was highly ____ and convinced the board to invest. (Persuasiva).
We must focus on our core ____ rather than expanding too quickly. (Competencias principales).
This new policy will completely change the ____ in our favor. (Dinámica).
questions.explanation: Change the dynamic = cambiar la dinámica.

questions.question: We need to ____ a sense of urgency to get this approved faster. (Infundir/Inyectar).
questions.explanation: Instill a sense of urgency = infundir un sentido de urgencia.

questions.question: Instead of arguing, she used a soft-____ approach to persuade them. (Táctica suave/Venta sutil).
questions.explanation: Soft-sell approach = enfoque de venta o persuasión suave, sutil y sin presión.

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe la palabra de persuasión correcta.

questions.question: To ____ our network. (Aprovechar/Apalancar con L)
____ on the trend. (Sacar partido con C)
We had to ____. (Cambiar de dirección/Pivotar con P)
Create massive ____. (Sinergias con S)
Get the board's ____. (Apoyo/Aceptación con B)
She will ____ it. (Liderar/Encabezar con S)
Unique ____ proposition. (Propuesta de valor con V)
Elevator ____. (Discurso rápido con P)
A ____ argument. (Irrefutable con W)
Build ____. (Sintonía/Buena relación con R)
